rules.nicheDetails: Keep specific niches in template names and descriptions. Reuse these tags; do not add synonyms or niche tags.

purposeDefinitions.Product launch: A new product, collection, release or season announcement.
purposeDefinitions.Update: Progress, client or account news, product improvements and reports.
purposeDefinitions.Newsletter: Editorial content, guides, recommendations and recurring selections.
purposeDefinitions.Event: An invitation, class, workshop, schedule or programme.
purposeDefinitions.Service: Booking or explaining a professional service, consultation or workspace.
purposeDefinitions.Fundraising: An appeal for donations or material contributions.
purposeDefinitions.Promotion: An existing offer, membership, subscription, restock or seasonal selection.
